decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's strategy of binding mobile communication and trusted second-channel interactions, so it remains core to the offer.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture got its own page in 2019 and underpins the integrated app and browser protection offer, making it a lasting platform element.
The QR-based hardware token was given its own page and serves regulated customers needing strong compliant authentication, though demand for hardware may shrink as app-based methods win.

The payment security compliance suite addresses ongoing regulatory requirements in payments and builds on established competence, but it is only mentioned on the site and is more peripheral, so it carries moderate risk.
